```{r}
rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)
library(purrr)
library(haven)

cmps16_path <- file.path("data", "cmps_2016.rda")
cmps20_path <- file.path("data", "cmps_2020.rda")
gss_path    <- file.path("data", "gss_1972_2024.sav")

fig_dir  <- "figures"
csv_path <- file.path(fig_dir, "three_pillars_clean.csv")
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)

theme_paper <- function(base_size = 11) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = base_size + 1),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30", size = base_size - 1),
          plot.caption  = element_text(color = "grey40", size = base_size - 3,
                                       hjust = 0),
          legend.position  = "bottom",
          strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold"),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}

pal_two <- c("Non-White immigrants" = "#1f78b4",
             "Non-White natives"    = "#e31a1c")

save_fig <- function(p, name, w = 9, h = 5) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible(NULL))
  ggsave(filename = file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  message("[ok] ", name)
}

load_rda <- function(path) {
  e <- new.env(); load(path, envir = e); get(ls(e)[1], envir = e)
}

to_num <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x, c("haven_labelled","labelled"))) {
    return(as.numeric(haven::zap_labels(x)))
  }
  if (is.factor(x)) {
    lvls <- levels(x)
    n1 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(lvls))
    if (sum(!is.na(n1)) >= length(lvls) * 0.8) {
      return(as.numeric(as.character(x)))
    }
    m  <- regmatches(lvls, regexpr("^\\s*\\(?\\s*(-?\\d+)", lvls))
    n2 <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[^-0-9]", "", m)))
    if (length(n2) == length(lvls) &&
        sum(!is.na(n2)) >= length(lvls) * 0.8) {
      return(n2[as.integer(x)])
    }
    return(as.integer(x))
  }
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
}

coerce_cols <- function(data, cols) {
  for (cc in intersect(cols, names(data))) data[[cc]] <- to_num(data[[cc]])
  data
}

prop_by <- function(data, group, var, w = "weight") {
  if (nrow(data) == 0 || !all(c(group, var, w) %in% names(data))) {
    return(tibble(group = character(), mean = numeric(), n = integer()))
  }
  d <- data %>%
    select(all_of(c(group, var, w))) %>%
    rename(.g = !!group, .v = !!var, .w = !!w)
  d$.v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$.v))
  d$.w <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(d$.w))
  d <- d %>% filter(!is.na(.g), !is.na(.v))
  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(tibble(group = character(), mean = numeric(), n = integer()))
  }
  d %>% group_by(.g) %>%
    summarise(mean = sum(.v * .w, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(.w, na.rm = TRUE),
              n    = sum(!is.na(.v)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    rename(group = .g)
}

battery_table <- function(data, group, vars, var_labels, w = "weight") {
  map_dfr(seq_along(vars), function(i) {
    pt <- prop_by(data, group, vars[i], w)
    if (nrow(pt) == 0) return(NULL)
    pt %>% mutate(item = var_labels[i], variable = vars[i])
  })
}

add_n <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(lbl = sprintf("%s (n=%s)",
                              scales::percent(mean, accuracy = 1),
                              scales::comma(n)))
}

cmps16 <- load_rda(cmps16_path)
cmps20 <- load_rda(cmps20_path)
gss    <- read_sav(gss_path)

names(cmps16) <- toupper(names(cmps16))
names(cmps20) <- toupper(names(cmps20))
names(gss)    <- toupper(names(gss))

cmps16 <- coerce_cols(cmps16,
  c("S7","ETHNIC_QUOTA","C14","C251","C280","WEIGHT"))
cmps20 <- coerce_cols(cmps20,
  c("S7","S2_RACE_PRIME","Q14","Q627","Q281R2","Q281R3","Q281R4","WEIGHT"))
gss <- coerce_cols(gss,
  c("YEAR","BORN","RACECEN1","HISPANIC","PRES16","PRES20",
    "AMBETTER","AMCITIZN","PROUDDEM","PROUDHIS",
    "DISRSPCT","POORSERV","NOTSMART","AFRAIDOF","THREATEN","WTSSPS"))

cmps16 <- cmps16 %>%
  mutate(
    immigrant = case_when(S7 == 2 ~ "Immigrants",
                          S7 == 1 ~ "Natives",
                          TRUE    ~ NA_character_),
    nonwhite  = ETHNIC_QUOTA != 1,
    compare_nw = case_when(
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Immigrants" ~ "Non-White immigrants",
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Natives"    ~ "Non-White natives",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    discrim_ever  = ifelse(C251 == 1, 1, ifelse(C251 == 2, 0, NA)),
    police_unfair = ifelse(C280 %in% 1:2, 1, ifelse(C280 == 3, 0, NA)),
    vote_trump    = case_when(C14 == 2 ~ 1,
                              C14 %in% c(1,3,4,5) ~ 0,
                              TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    weight = WEIGHT
  )

cmps20 <- cmps20 %>%
  mutate(
    immigrant = case_when(S7 == 2 ~ "Immigrants",
                          S7 == 1 ~ "Natives",
                          TRUE    ~ NA_character_),
    nonwhite  = S2_RACE_PRIME != 1,
    compare_nw = case_when(
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Immigrants" ~ "Non-White immigrants",
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Natives"    ~ "Non-White natives",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),
    discrim_ever   = ifelse(Q627 == 1, 1, ifelse(Q627 == 2, 0, NA)),
    discrim_police = ifelse(Q281R2 == 1, 1, ifelse(Q281R2 == 0, 0, NA)),
    discrim_immig  = ifelse(Q281R3 == 1, 1, ifelse(Q281R3 == 0, 0, NA)),
    discrim_work   = ifelse(Q281R4 == 1, 1, ifelse(Q281R4 == 0, 0, NA)),
    vote_trump = case_when(Q14 == 1 ~ 1,
                           Q14 %in% c(2,3,4,5,6) ~ 0,
                           TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    weight = WEIGHT
  )

gss <- gss %>%
  mutate(
    immigrant = case_when(BORN == 2 ~ "Immigrants",
                          BORN == 1 ~ "Natives",
                          TRUE      ~ NA_character_),
    nonwhite  = (RACECEN1 != 1) | (!is.na(HISPANIC) & HISPANIC != 1),
    compare_nw = case_when(
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Immigrants" ~ "Non-White immigrants",
      !is.na(immigrant) & nonwhite & immigrant == "Natives"    ~ "Non-White natives",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_),

    disc_disrspct = ifelse(DISRSPCT %in% 1:4, 1,
                    ifelse(DISRSPCT %in% 5:6, 0, NA)),
    disc_service  = ifelse(POORSERV %in% 1:4, 1,
                    ifelse(POORSERV %in% 5:6, 0, NA)),
    disc_notsmart = ifelse(NOTSMART %in% 1:4, 1,
                    ifelse(NOTSMART %in% 5:6, 0, NA)),
    disc_afraidof = ifelse(AFRAIDOF %in% 1:4, 1,
                    ifelse(AFRAIDOF %in% 5:6, 0, NA)),
    disc_threaten = ifelse(THREATEN %in% 1:4, 1,
                    ifelse(THREATEN %in% 5:6, 0, NA)),

    nat_proud_dem = ifelse(PROUDDEM %in% 1:2, 1,
                    ifelse(PROUDDEM %in% 3:4, 0, NA)),
    nat_proud_his = ifelse(PROUDHIS %in% 1:2, 1,
                    ifelse(PROUDHIS %in% 3:4, 0, NA)),
    nat_better    = ifelse(AMBETTER %in% 1:2, 1,
                    ifelse(AMBETTER %in% 3:5, 0, NA)),
    nat_rather_us = ifelse(AMCITIZN %in% 1:2, 1,
                    ifelse(AMCITIZN %in% 3:5, 0, NA)),

    vote_trump16 = case_when(PRES16 == 2 ~ 1,
                             PRES16 %in% c(1,3,4) ~ 0,
                             TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    vote_trump20 = case_when(PRES20 == 2 ~ 1,
                             PRES20 %in% c(1,3,4) ~ 0,
                             TRUE ~ NA_real_),

    weight = WTSSPS
  )

disc_cmps <- bind_rows(
  prop_by(filter(cmps16, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "discrim_ever") %>%
    mutate(item = "Ever discriminated", source = "CMPS 2016"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps20, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "discrim_ever") %>%
    mutate(item = "Ever discriminated", source = "CMPS 2020"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps16, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "police_unfair") %>%
    mutate(item = "Police mistreatment", source = "CMPS 2016"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps20, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "discrim_police") %>%
    mutate(item = "Police discrimination", source = "CMPS 2020"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps20, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "discrim_immig") %>%
    mutate(item = "Immigration officer discrim.", source = "CMPS 2020"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps20, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "discrim_work") %>%
    mutate(item = "Workplace discrim.", source = "CMPS 2020")
) %>% add_n()

p <- ggplot(disc_cmps, aes(x = mean, y = item, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lbl, x = mean),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            hjust = -0.05, size = 2.7, color = "grey20") +
  facet_wrap(~ source, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.30))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_two, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "PILLAR 1: Discrimination experiences (CMPS)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Source: CMPS 2016 + 2020. Weighted.") +
  theme_paper()
save_fig(p, "P1_discrimination_cmps", w = 11, h = 8)

gss_disc_vars <- c("disc_disrspct","disc_service","disc_notsmart",
                   "disc_afraidof","disc_threaten")
gss_disc_labs <- c("Treated with less respect",
                   "Worse service",
                   "Treated as not smart",
                   "People act afraid",
                   "Threatened or harassed")

gss_disc_years <- gss %>% group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(any_disc = any(!is.na(disc_disrspct)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_disc) %>% pull(YEAR)

disc_gss <- map_dfr(gss_disc_years, function(yy) {
  sub <- gss %>% filter(YEAR == yy, !is.na(compare_nw))
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  battery_table(sub, "compare_nw", gss_disc_vars, gss_disc_labs) %>%
    mutate(wave = paste0("GSS ", yy))
})

if (nrow(disc_gss) > 0) {
  disc_gss <- disc_gss %>%
    mutate(item = factor(item, levels = rev(gss_disc_labs)),
           wave = factor(wave, levels = paste0("GSS ", sort(gss_disc_years)))) %>%
    add_n()

  p <- ggplot(disc_gss, aes(x = mean, y = item, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lbl, x = mean),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
              hjust = -0.05, size = 2.5, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ wave, ncol = 2) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_two, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "PILLAR 1: Everyday discrimination (GSS)",
         subtitle = "% experiencing each form 'a few times a year' or more often",
         x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = "Source: GSS everyday discrimination battery. Weighted.") +
    theme_paper()
  save_fig(p, "P1_discrimination_gss",
           w = 13, h = max(7, 3 * length(gss_disc_years)))
}

pride_vars <- c("nat_proud_dem","nat_proud_his","nat_better","nat_rather_us")
pride_labs <- c("Proud of democracy",
                "Proud of U.S. history",
                "U.S. is a better country",
                "Rather be U.S. citizen")

pride_years <- gss %>% group_by(YEAR) %>%
  summarise(any_pride = any(!is.na(nat_proud_dem)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(any_pride) %>% pull(YEAR)

pride_gss <- map_dfr(pride_years, function(yy) {
  sub <- gss %>% filter(YEAR == yy, !is.na(compare_nw))
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  battery_table(sub, "compare_nw", pride_vars, pride_labs) %>%
    mutate(wave = paste0("GSS ", yy))
})

if (nrow(pride_gss) > 0) {
  pride_gss <- pride_gss %>%
    mutate(item = factor(item, levels = rev(pride_labs)),
           wave = factor(wave, levels = paste0("GSS ", sort(pride_years)))) %>%
    add_n()

  p <- ggplot(pride_gss, aes(x = mean, y = item, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lbl, x = mean),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
              hjust = -0.05, size = 2.5, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ wave, ncol = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.35))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_two, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "PILLAR 2: National pride (GSS)",
         subtitle = "% endorsing each item ('agree' / 'proud' or stronger)",
         x = NULL, y = NULL,
         caption = "Source: GSS ISSP National Identity battery. Weighted.") +
    theme_paper()
  save_fig(p, "P2_pride_gss",
           w = 11, h = max(6, 3.2 * length(pride_years)))
}

trump_cmps <- bind_rows(
  prop_by(filter(cmps16, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "vote_trump") %>%
    mutate(source = "CMPS 2016"),
  prop_by(filter(cmps20, !is.na(compare_nw)), "compare_nw", "vote_trump") %>%
    mutate(source = "CMPS 2020")
) %>% add_n()

p <- ggplot(trump_cmps, aes(x = source, y = mean, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = lbl, y = mean),
            position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3, color = "grey20") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal_two, name = NULL) +
  labs(title = "PILLAR 3: Trump vote (CMPS)",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "Source: CMPS 2016 (C14) + CMPS 2020 (Q14). Weighted.") +
  theme_paper()
save_fig(p, "P3_trump_cmps", w = 9, h = 5)

trump_gss <- map_dfr(c(2022, 2024), function(yy) {
  sub <- gss %>% filter(YEAR == yy, !is.na(compare_nw))
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(
    prop_by(sub, "compare_nw", "vote_trump16") %>%
      mutate(election = "2016", gss_year = paste0("GSS ", yy)),
    prop_by(sub, "compare_nw", "vote_trump20") %>%
      mutate(election = "2020", gss_year = paste0("GSS ", yy))
  )
}) %>% add_n()

if (nrow(trump_gss) > 0) {
  p <- ggplot(trump_gss, aes(x = election, y = mean, fill = group)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.65) +
    geom_text(aes(label = lbl, y = mean),
              position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
              vjust = -0.5, size = 2.7, color = "grey20") +
    facet_wrap(~ gss_year) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.20))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal_two, name = NULL) +
    labs(title = "PILLAR 3: Trump vote (GSS retrospective)",
         x = "Election", y = NULL,
         caption = "Source: GSS PRES16 / PRES20. Weighted.") +
    theme_paper()
  save_fig(p, "P3_trump_gss", w = 11, h = 5)
}

all_results <- bind_rows(
  disc_cmps  %>% mutate(figure = "P1_cmps"),
  disc_gss   %>% mutate(figure = "P1_gss"),
  pride_gss  %>% mutate(figure = "P2_gss"),
  trump_cmps %>% mutate(figure = "P3_cmps"),
  trump_gss  %>% mutate(figure = "P3_gss")
)

write.csv(all_results, csv_path, row.names = FALSE,
          fileEncoding = "UTF-8", na = "")

message("\nWrote ", nrow(all_results), " rows to:\n  ", csv_path)
message("Figures saved to:\n  ", fig_dir)
message("Done.")

```
